# `liber:bmc@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:bmc` package (`bmc.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem BMC - what a baseboard management controller holds, read through the system's IPMI interfaces: its identity, its sensors, its event log, its FRU inventory, its chassis and its LAN configuration.  TWO INTERFACES FOR TWO PARTIES. The `ipmi-provider` contract is what one `ipmi` driver binding serves to the BMC service - the only consumer of the `ipmi` provider kind. The `bmc` interface is what the BMC service serves to the `bmc` tool. NEITHER CARRIES A RAW COMMAND, AND NEITHER CAN STOP THE MACHINE OR ERASE THE LOG: those are administrative actions, carried by the driver's executor publications, which only AdminService reaches. The provider contract's only writes are `system-event` - one of the two events below, built by the driver - and the identify light.  A BMC ANSWERS WITH A COMPLETION CODE, and every reply that asked the BMC carries a `status` saying what it did: it answered, it refused with a code, it is unavailable, or its answer was refused as malformed. `error` is kept for the call itself failing - a BMC this service does not hold, a request out of bounds.

## Imports

- `error` from [`liber:base@1`](/docs/gen/liber/base/v1.md)

## Types

### enum `outcome`

What happened when the BMC was asked.

| case | ordinal | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `answered` | 1 |  |
| `refused` | 2 | The BMC answered with a completion code other than success: `cc` says which. |
| `unavailable` | 3 | The BMC is unavailable - three transactions in a row timed out - or the interface did not answer. |
| `malformed` | 4 | The answer arrived and was refused: too long, the wrong length, not the request's. |

## Interfaces

### interface `ipmi-provider`

THE DRIVER'S CONTRACT, to the BMC service alone.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `describe` | `describe() -> result<binding-info, error>` |  |
| 2 | `changes` | `changes() -> stream<change>` | Availability and identity changes, as they happen. |
| 3 | `sensors` | `sensors() -> result<sensors, error>` | Every sensor the repository declares, each read now. |
| 4 | `sel-info` | `sel-info() -> result<sel-info, error>` |  |
| 5 | `sel-page` | `sel-page(first: u16) -> result<sel-page, error>` | Up to sixteen entries from record `first`. |
| 6 | `fru` | `fru() -> result<fru, error>` |  |
| 7 | `chassis` | `chassis() -> result<chassis, error>` |  |
| 8 | `identify` | `identify(seconds: u8) -> result<status, error>` | The identify light, on for 1 to 255 seconds, or off with 0. |
| 9 | `lan` | `lan() -> result<lan, error>` |  |
| 10 | `system-event` | `system-event(kind: system-event-kind) -> result<status, error>` | One of the system's own events into the BMC's log. |

### interface `bmc`

THE TOOL'S INTERFACE, served by the BMC service. Every operation but `list` names the BMC by its name.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `list` | `list() -> result<list<bmc-summary>, error>` |  |
| 2 | `sensors` | `sensors(name: string) -> result<sensors, error>` |  |
| 3 | `sel-info` | `sel-info(name: string) -> result<sel-info, error>` |  |
| 4 | `sel-page` | `sel-page(name: string, first: u16) -> result<sel-page, error>` |  |
| 5 | `sel-follow` | `sel-follow(name: string) -> stream<sel-entry>` | The log FOLLOWED: each entry the BMC adds from now on, found by polling its most recent addition. |
| 6 | `fru` | `fru(name: string) -> result<fru, error>` |  |
| 7 | `chassis` | `chassis(name: string) -> result<chassis, error>` |  |
| 8 | `identify` | `identify(name: string, seconds: u8) -> result<status, error>` |  |
| 9 | `lan` | `lan(name: string) -> result<lan, error>` |  |
